Cam: Final four watch party tonight? pizza + projector in the kitchen?
Priya M: I'm in. pepperoni + one vegan pie pls.
Luis: Can someone bring a spare HDMI? My laptop hates projectors.
Jules: I have HDMI and an adapter. bringing it.
Nora: Reminder: lineup locks at 6am tomorrow. anyone making last-minute changes?
Priya M: Yep, moving in a kicker and switching WRs. thanks for the reminder.
Cam: Also small stakes: loser of today's group picks buys bagels Monday? fair?
Luis: Deal. I'll take that bet.
Jules: Vote for pizza: pepperoni, margherita, vegan. leaguebot: poll created "Tonight's pizza types?" Voting open 3h.
leaguebot: votes recorded: Cam pepperoni, Priya M vegan, Luis pepperoni, Jules margherita.
Ava: Can we keep spoilers out of #random until the last game ends? got to protect the folks on different timezones.
Nora: Yes, no-score posts until midnight. post highlights in #sports-highlights.
Cam: Perfect. I'll order pizza at 7pm and reserve the kitchen projector. See y'all there :pizza:
